source: GameplayData.ManaValues (config) and the game's CharacterUtils.GenerateSkillMana (read from the game code).

formula.when: Every battle update while an Invoker is performing a skill or combo (ScriptUpdateSystem passes the time the skill ran), if the Invoker is alive and its team is in battle.
formula.ultimateMana: time x ultimatePerSecond x modeMultiplier.ultimate x (1 + manaGenerationPct/100) x manaburnFactor
formula.titanMana: time x titanPerSecond x modeMultiplier.titan x (1 + manaGenerationPct/100) x manaburnFactor (added to the team's shared Titan mana)
formula.manaGenerationPct: stat_curves.json ManaRegenRecoveryPct at the Invoker's Mana Generation rating
formula.manaburnFactor: CorruptionUtils.DotCorruptionReductionFactor for Manaburn Corruption (1 when the boss has no Manaburn; reduced by Manaburn Tolerance)
formula.modeOrder: pvp if Arena, else factionWars, else spires (Tower regions), else fourHeroes if the battle allows at most 4 heroes, else fiveHeroes. A stage's ManaMultipliersOverride value replaces the mode value when it is above 0.

example: A 4-hero PvE battle at Mana Generation 0: 18.33 x 2 = 36.66 Ultimate mana per second of skill/combo time, so a 900-mana Ultimate after ~24.5 s of acting.
notes: Mana is gained by time spent acting, not per hit: long animations do not give more mana per second.
Extra mana from specific skills (ManaGeneration blocks) is in skill_mechanics.json `mana`.
Stage overrides: bosses.json-level stages carry ManaMultipliersOverride (e.g. relic boss stages set Ultimate 1-2, Titan 0).
unconfirmed: Starting mana 0 is inferred from the absence of any setting; not observed in game.
startingMana: No starting-mana setting exists in the game config or code (searched GameplayData, ManaValues, battle setup): Ultimate and Titan mana start at 0, unless a skill script grants mana (skill_mechanics.json mana).
ultimateCooldown: The Ultimate's 15 s cooldown is a normal skill cooldown (CanCooldownBeReduced = true), so Skill Recovery shortens it like any other: base / recovery factor (timing.json).
